comparison.objective: Carry a tray and upright cup using both handles, then set it in zone C; candidate performs insert finishing and fragment recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated load transport and level tray placement versus stabilizing a narrow coaxial mandrel during hammering and recovering millimetre-scale tangs.
comparison.success_condition: Tray delivered to zone C with cup upright versus four valid fractures and four contained fragments without insert or shell damage. Setup, scoring, run limit, fidelity, and reset details are missing.
comparison.reason: Even with an incomplete board rubric, balanced transport tests a meaningfully different ability from precision impact tooling and debris recovery.
